problem: merge now overwrites the lower-bound flag with `plc = lc` and only when the new interval reaches further, so a closed start sorted first becomes open, e.g. normalize([(0,1),(0,2,False,True)]) returns (0,2,False,True) instead of (0,2,True,True); normalize, union, intersection and difference are all affected.
The change to merge comes with no tests, and nothing covers intervals that share a start point with mixed open/closed flags, the case that would have caught F1.
